h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10minus-20261023-71329.hypothesis: R0's dots that sit in the near-catalogue collar carry less credit than the metric's break-even, so deleting them raises DTI even though some are close to known traces.
h33-h33-2-b2-MASSm10minus-20261023-71329.mechanism: Binary-dot algebra (vendor/gems57/metric.py): DTI = T/(0.2*(T+n-M)+0.8|G|). Removing one dot lowers the denominator by exactly 0.2 regardless of its credit, so a removal gains iff that dot's realised credit to unseen truth is below 0.2*DTI = 0.0556 at DTI 0.2778. The removed set is concentrated in the collar, which is the region where the 0.2708->0.2778 prune paid.

h33-h33-2-b2-CONCb10px-m10-20261023-89ff.hypothesis: At a fixed dot count, raising local dot density on the parent's most confident km-scale clusters raises the metric more than the relocation costs, because the metric's false-positive term is sum_x p(x)(1 - max_g k): a dot welded next to an already-covering dot pays almost no penalty (0.2(1 - k) ~ 0.07 at 1 px) while a dot in an empty km block pays the full 0.2. Mass moved out of the coldest blocks therefore relieves denominator weight that the parent was still paying.
h33-h33-2-b2-CONCb10px-m10-20261023-89ff.mechanism: DTI = T / (0.2T + 0.2(n - M) + 0.8|G|) with n fixed at 37654. Each move changes the denominator by 0.2(t_add - t_rm + m_rm - m_add). Donors are drawn from the coldest 1 km blocks (mean block prior 0.75 dots/km2) where m_rm ~ 0; receivers land in blocks with mean prior 2.54 dots/km2 at 1.04 px from a surviving host, so m_add is inherited from the host's proximity to truth. No new pixels enter the catalogue collar and no block is emptied.
h33-h33-2-b2-CONCb10px-m10-20261023-89ff.non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan benches and GeoDAWN E-W flight-line corrugation both survive edge filters and pack into km-scale bands; welding dots onto them raises M only if the host is actually near truth, so a mimic shows up as a null (m_add ~ 0), not a false gain. Conversely, alluvial geothermal outflow along range fronts forms km-scale clusters with no fault slip, which would produce a real m_add but nothing in T.

Under every estimator tried, R0 sits at 0.62 (raw 1 km counts, occupied blocks) / 0.48 (5 km-smoothed density); these variants push it to 1.02-1.36 / 0.67-1.07, far outside the 0.51-0.59 band the brief quotes for the best files. Live change >= +0.010 with the 20 % move > 10 % move: mechanism confirmed, scale the dose and combine with the best MASS setting next session.
